# Security Policy

This repository contains educational examples and documentation for Turtle4J. Please do not post credentials, access tokens, private keys, personal data, or sensitive device information in issues or pull requests.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability, please **do not open a public issue**. Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option under the repository's Security tab if available. If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository maintainer privately through their GitHub profile before sharing details publicly.

For ordinary bugs in examples or documentation, use the bug report issue template. Never include real credentials in logs or screenshots.

## Supported content

The latest version of the examples on the default branch is the primary maintained version. Older snapshots may not receive fixes. This repository does not publish or maintain the underlying library implementation.
